versions.changelog: New icon. The shared helper keeps its connection file private, clears update records on the last disconnect, and keeps the network route you chose when an update check fails.
Balance and cost questions now answer from a live account read rather than from figures written into the package.

community-site-clip 0.1.1

- Initial release: Generate one silent 2–15s video clip per authorized community event photo, each using facts supplied by the office.
- Clips are created in photo capture order without stitching or batching; each photo yields a separate motion clip.
- Default settings select 5s duration if not specified, maintain original aspect ratio, and avoid generating text or audio from images.
- Planning, pricing quotes, and confirmation steps are separate from the paid video generation.
- All Beatra operations are performed exclusively through the bundled MCP client, with strict workflow for balance checks, recovery, and updates.
- Includes detailed scope, input handling, recovery, and update guarantees.
